author: HAI
releaseNotes:
HAI Engine (Preview) 0.5.89: a rule engine for Hubitat, an alternative to Rule Machine, with a rule editor in your browser.

This is a preview for invited testers. Expect rough edges, and keep your Rule Machine rules until you trust the HAI copies.

An install or update takes 10 to 15 minutes while the hub compiles the apps. Leave the page open until it finishes; your rules keep running.

* Rule editor: open it from the HAI Engine page. Build rules from triggers, conditions and actions in everyday words, check them, put them on the hub stopped, and start them when ready. Start from a pattern, or open the Showcase rule to see much of what HAI can do.
* AI Rule Assistant (optional): describe a rule in plain words and it drafts one for you to review. It needs your own Claude API key and a spending limit, under AI token and cost management. Everything else works without it.
* Each rule runs as its own small app on the hub, with its run history.
* Backups: a backup of your rules every night, and Back up now at any time. Restore one rule or all.
* HAI Migration (installed, off until you turn it on in HAI Engine): copies Rule Machine rules into HAI one at a time. Each copy starts stopped; Switch over pauses the Rule Machine rule and starts the copy, and Switch back reverses it. Needs Automation Map 2.4.36 or later (its Dev channel for now, see INSTALL.md), with a scan done.
* Off until you switch them on: the MCP endpoint for AI assistants, and the web address for dashboards and shortcuts.

After installing: Apps, Add user app, HAI Engine (Preview). Open the rule editor from its page, check Approved devices, and press Done.

Report a problem or give feedback: More, Report a problem or give feedback in the editor, or the Issues tab of the HAI-Engine repository on GitHub. Report security problems privately, as SECURITY.md explains.
